zh: 老师把答案写在黑板上了。
py: lǎo shī bǎ dá àn xiě zài hēi bǎn shàng le
en: The teacher wrote the answers on the blackboard.
why: 写在 plus a place with a specific object means 把 first. The place stays right after 写在, and 了 closes the sentence.

zh: 我把作业写完了。
py: wǒ bǎ zuò yè xiě wán le
en: I've finished my homework.
why: 把 moves 作业 in front of the verb, and the verb stays glued to its result 完, with 了 last. The object cannot sit between 写 and 完.

s: 你别把窗户关上，屋里太热了。
s_py: nǐ bié bǎ chuāng hu guān shàng wū lǐ tài rè le
zh: 你别把窗户关上，屋里太热了。
py: nǐ bié bǎ chuāng hu guān shàng wū lǐ tài rè le
en: Don't close the window; it's too hot in the room.
why: 别 before 把, and 关上 keeps its result. This is the normal prohibition.

s: 你把自行车可以放在门口。
s_py: nǐ bǎ zì xíng chē kě yǐ fàng zài mén kǒu
zh: 你可以把自行车放在门口。
py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ zì xíng chē fàng zài mén kǒu
en: You can leave your bike at the door.
why: Modal verbs like 可以 go before 把. They cannot appear between the object and the verb.

src: 小王弄丢了会议室的钥匙。
src_py: xiǎo wáng nòng diū le huì yì shì de yào shi
zh: 小王把会议室的钥匙弄丢了。
py: xiǎo wáng bǎ huì yì shì de yào shi nòng diū le
en: Xiao Wang has lost the meeting room key.
why: The key is specific, so it goes after 把. 弄丢 keeps its result and 了 ends the clause.

s: 我把作业做。
s_py: wǒ bǎ zuò yè zuò
zh: 我把作业做完了。
py: wǒ bǎ zuò yè zuò wán le
en: I've finished my homework.
why: The verb after 把 must be followed by something, such as the result 完 and 了. 做 alone does not work.

q: 你___把这件事告诉别人，这是公司的秘密。
zh: 你不要把这件事告诉别人，这是公司的秘密。
py: nǐ bù yào bǎ zhè jiàn shì gào su bié ren zhè shì gōng sī de mì mì
en: Don't tell anyone about this; it's a company secret.
why: 'Don't' is 不要 before 把. 没 reports a past non-event, and 不是 and 不会 do not warn someone against doing something.

s: 同学们没把作业交上来。
s_py: tóng xué men méi bǎ zuò yè jiāo shàng lái
zh: 同学们没把作业交上来。
py: tóng xué men méi bǎ zuò yè jiāo shàng lái
en: The students didn't hand in their homework.
why: 没 before 把, with the direction 上来 kept together and no 了. This is the correct negative.

s: 他翻译这个句子成中文了。
s_py: tā fān yì zhè ge jù zi chéng zhōng wén le
zh: 他把这个句子翻译成中文了。
py: tā bǎ zhè ge jù zi fān yì chéng zhōng wén le
en: He translated this sentence into Chinese.
why: 翻译成 must be followed directly by the new form, so the sentence being translated has to go forward with 把.

q: 请把门关___。
zh: 请把门关上。
py: qǐng bǎ mén guān shàng
en: Please close the door.
why: After 把门 the verb needs a result, and 关上 says the door ends up shut. 着, 过 and 的 give no result, so the verb would be left bare.

q: 我很喜欢___这位新老师。
zh: 我很喜欢这位新老师。
py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhè wèi xīn lǎo shī
en: I really like this new teacher.
why: 喜欢 does nothing to its object, so it takes a plain object after the verb and never 把.

q: 老师___我的作业改完了。
zh: 老师把我的作业改完了。
py: lǎo shī bǎ wǒ de zuò yè gǎi wán le
en: The teacher has finished marking my homework.
why: The teacher does something to a specific object and ends with the result 完, which is the 把 pattern. 被 would make the teacher the one being marked, which is nonsense.

src_py: nǐ bǎ yī fu fàng zài dì shàng
zh: 你别把衣服放在地上。
py: nǐ bié bǎ yī fu fàng zài dì shàng
en: Don't put your clothes on the floor.
why: 别 goes before 把. Placing it between the object and the verb is not allowed.

src_py: nǐ guān yī xià dēng
task: Make it a polite request with 请 and 把.
zh: 请把灯关一下。
py: qǐng bǎ dēng guān yī xià
en: Please turn the light off.
why: The light goes after 把 and 一下 follows the verb as its ending. 请 replaces the subject 你.

q: 我把___本书看完了。
zh: 我把那本书看完了。
py: wǒ bǎ nà běn shū kàn wán le
en: I finished reading that book.
why: The 把 object must be specific, and 那 makes it 'that book'. 一, 两 and 几 would introduce an unspecified or counted book, which stays after the verb.

zh: 请你把会议需要的材料带过来。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ huì yì xū yào de cái liào dài guò lái
en: Please bring over the materials the meeting needs.
why: The long specific object goes after 把, and 带过来 follows as one block. The direction cannot be split off from the verb.

zh: 请把灯打开。
py: qǐng bǎ dēng dǎ kāi
en: Please turn on the light.
why: The object follows 把 straight away and 打开 stays together as verb plus result. A bare 打 would not be allowed.

zh: 我昨天看完了一本书。
py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn wán le yī běn shū
en: I finished a book yesterday.
why: A new, counted object like 一本书 stays after the verb. 把 would need a specific object such as 那本书. 昨天 may also come before 我.

src: 我昨天交了作业给李老师。
src_py: wǒ zuó tiān jiāo le zuò yè gěi lǐ lǎo shī
zh: 我昨天把作业交给了李老师。
py: wǒ zuó tiān bǎ zuò yè jiāo gěi le lǐ lǎo shī
en: I handed my homework to Teacher Li yesterday.
why: The homework goes after 把, and 交给了 is followed directly by the person receiving it. The time word may come before or after 我.

src: 他打开了办公室的门，走了进去。
src_py: tā dǎ kāi le bàn gōng shì de mén zǒu le jìn qù
task: Rewrite the first clause with 把.
zh: 他把办公室的门打开了，走了进去。
py: tā bǎ bàn gōng shì de mén dǎ kāi le zǒu le jìn qù
en: He opened the office door and walked in.
why: The door goes after 把 and 打开了 closes the first clause. The second clause, 走了进去, stays unchanged.

zh: 王老师把同学们交上来的作业都改完了。
py: wáng lǎo shī bǎ tóng xué men jiāo shàng lái de zuò yè dōu gǎi wán le
en: Teacher Wang has marked all the homework the students handed in.
why: The long object phrase goes right after 把, with 都 after it summing up the object. The verb keeps 完 and 了 at the end.

q: 他把杯子摔___了。
zh: 他把杯子摔坏了。
py: tā bǎ bēi zi shuāi huài le
en: He dropped the cup and broke it.
why: The result complement must say what became of the cup: 摔坏 means it broke. 摔完, 摔走 and 摔上 cannot describe a dropped cup.

src_py: wǒ zuò wán le liàn xí
zh: 我把练习做完了。
py: wǒ bǎ liàn xí zuò wán le
en: I finished the exercises.
why: The specific object goes after 把, and 做完 stays together before 了. 完 cannot be separated from 做.

zh: 我已经把邮件发给同事了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ yóu jiàn fā gěi tóng shì le
en: I've already sent the email to my colleagues.
why: The time adverb 已经 sits before 把. 发给 plus a person follows the object, and 了 ends the sentence.

q: 他把这篇课文翻译___了中文。
zh: 他把这篇课文翻译成了中文。
py: tā bǎ zhè piān kè wén fān yì chéng le zhōng wén
en: He translated this text into Chinese.
why: Turning one language into another is 翻译成, with the new form right after. 翻译给, 翻译在 and 翻译到 cannot introduce a language.

zh: 秘书把签好的合同送到了客户那里。
py: mì shū bǎ qiān hǎo de hé tong sòng dào le kè hù nà li
en: The secretary took the signed contract to the client.
why: 送到了 plus a place needs the object forward with 把. The signed contract is specific, and the place follows 送到了 directly.

q: 经理把我叫___办公室，问了我很多问题。
zh: 经理把我叫进办公室，问了我很多问题。
py: jīng lǐ bǎ wǒ jiào jìn bàn gōng shì wèn le wǒ hěn duō wèn tí
en: The manager called me into his office and asked me a lot of questions.
why: 叫进办公室 uses the direction 进 to say someone was called into a room. 叫下 and 叫起 do not take a room, and 叫上 would mean calling someone to come along.

zh: 经理把文件交给了秘书。
py: jīng lǐ bǎ wén jiàn jiāo gěi le mì shū
en: The manager handed the file to the secretary.
why: 交给 plus a person needs the file in front of the verb with 把. The recipient follows 交给了 directly.

q: 经理把会议推迟___下周一了。
zh: 经理把会议推迟到下周一了。
py: jīng lǐ bǎ huì yì tuī chí dào xià zhōu yī le
en: The manager postponed the meeting until next Monday.
why: 推迟到 gives the time something is moved to. 推迟在 and 推迟给 are not used, and 着 would only describe a state.

s: 我今天能把这些邮件回复完。
s_py: wǒ jīn tiān néng bǎ zhè xiē yóu jiàn huí fù wán
zh: 我今天能把这些邮件回复完。
py: wǒ jīn tiān néng bǎ zhè xiē yóu jiàn huí fù wán
en: I can finish replying to these emails today.
why: 能 comes before 把, with the result 完 on the verb. This is fine, unlike a potential form such as 回复不完 with 把.

src_py: wǒ bǎ zhè xiē yóu jiàn huí fù le
task: Say you already did it (已经).
zh: 我已经把这些邮件回复了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ zhè xiē yóu jiàn huí fù le
en: I've already replied to these emails.
why: The time adverb 已经 goes before 把. The verb ends with 了.

src_py: qǐng jiāo zuò yè gěi lǎo shī
zh: 请把作业交给老师。
py: qǐng bǎ zuò yè jiāo gěi lǎo shī
en: Please hand your homework to the teacher.
why: 把 puts the homework before the verb, and 交给 is followed straight away by the person receiving it.

zh: 请把房间打扫一下。
py: qǐng bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo yī xià
en: Please tidy up the room a bit.
why: With no result, 一下 gives the verb the ending that 把 needs. 打扫 alone would be a bare verb.

src_py: wǒ bǎ zuò yè dài lái le
zh: 我没把作业带来。
py: wǒ méi bǎ zuò yè dài lái
en: I didn't bring my homework.
why: 没 goes before 把, and the 了 is dropped. 我把作业没带来 puts the negator in the wrong place.

s: 小王把我们公司的经理认识。
s_py: xiǎo wáng bǎ wǒ men gōng sī de jīng lǐ rèn shi
zh: 小王认识我们公司的经理。
py: xiǎo wáng rèn shi wǒ men gōng sī de jīng lǐ
en: Xiao Wang knows our company's manager.
why: 认识 states knowing and does nothing to the manager, so no 把.

s: 请把这份文件复印两份。
s_py: qǐng bǎ zhè fèn wén jiàn fù yìn liǎng fèn
zh: 请把这份文件复印两份。
py: qǐng bǎ zhè fèn wén jiàn fù yìn liǎng fèn
en: Please make two copies of this document.
why: The 把 object 这份文件 is specific. The counted 两份 is the amount of copies, not the object, so this is correct.

src_py: lǎo shī gěi le wǒ zuò yè běn
task: Rewrite with 把, keeping 给.
zh: 老师把作业本给我了。
py: lǎo shī bǎ zuò yè běn gěi wǒ le
en: The teacher gave me my exercise book.
why: With 把 the thing given goes before the verb, and 给 is followed by the person. 了 may sit after 给 or at the end.

s: 他每天把咖啡喝。
s_py: tā měi tiān bǎ kā fēi hē
zh: 他每天喝咖啡。
py: tā měi tiān hē kā fēi
en: He drinks coffee every day.
why: A habit has no specific outcome for the object, so it takes plain SVO. 把 would also leave 喝 bare.

src_py: tóng xué men ná lái le yǐ zi
zh: 同学们把椅子拿来了。
py: tóng xué men bǎ yǐ zi ná lái le
en: The students brought the chairs over.
why: The chairs are specific, so they go after 把. The verb keeps its direction 来 and ends in 了.

zh: 小李把箱子搬上楼了。
py: xiǎo lǐ bǎ xiāng zi bān shàng lóu le
en: Xiao Li carried the box upstairs.
why: The box goes after 把 and the direction 搬上楼 stays together after the verb. The object cannot be put between 搬 and 上楼.

q: 他昨天忘了，所以___把报告交给经理。
zh: 他昨天忘了，所以没把报告交给经理。
py: tā zuó tiān wàng le suǒ yǐ méi bǎ bào gào jiāo gěi jīng lǐ
en: He forgot yesterday, so he didn't hand the report to the manager.
why: An action that did not happen in the past is 没 before 把, with no 了. 不 would be a refusal, which clashes with having forgotten; 别 and 要 are commands or wishes.

s: 我在走廊里把李老师看见了。
s_py: wǒ zài zǒu láng lǐ bǎ lǐ lǎo shī kàn jiàn le
zh: 我在走廊里看见李老师了。
py: wǒ zài zǒu láng lǐ kàn jiàn lǐ lǎo shī le
en: I saw Teacher Li in the corridor.
why: Seeing someone does not change them, so 看见 takes a plain object after the verb.

zh: 请把这些材料送到会议室去。
py: qǐng bǎ zhè xiē cái liào sòng dào huì yì shì qù
en: Please take these materials to the meeting room.
why: 送到 plus a place needs the object up front with 把. The object cannot come after 送到, because the place has to follow it directly.

src_py: tā bǎ bào gào jiāo gěi jīng lǐ le
task: Say he still hasn't done it (还没).
zh: 他还没把报告交给经理。
py: tā hái méi bǎ bào gào jiāo gěi jīng lǐ
en: He still hasn't given the report to the manager.
why: 还没 goes before 把 and takes away the 了. 把报告还没交 would be wrong.

zh: 我把笔记本放在桌子上了。
py: wǒ bǎ bǐ jì běn fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
en: I put my notebook on the desk.
why: With 放在 plus a place, the specific object must go forward with 把. 我放笔记本在桌子上了 is the English-style order that Chinese does not allow.

q: 请把这封信交___李老师。
zh: 请把这封信交给李老师。
py: qǐng bǎ zhè fēng xìn jiāo gěi lǐ lǎo shī
en: Please hand this letter to Teacher Li.
why: 交给 is 'hand over to' a person. 交在 and 交成 do not work, and 交到 needs a place or a 手里 after the person.

src_py: nǐ bǎ chē tíng zài zhè r
zh: 你可以把车停在这儿。
py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ chē tíng zài zhè r
en: You can park the car here.
why: The modal 可以 stands before 把. The object stays in front of the verb and 在这儿 follows 停.

q: 学生把答案写___了，老师让他重写。
zh: 学生把答案写错了，老师让他重写。
py: xué sheng bǎ dá àn xiě cuò le lǎo shī ràng tā chóng xiě
en: The student wrote the answer wrong, so the teacher made him write it again.
why: The result is that the answer is wrong, so 错 is needed; the cue and the order to rewrite exclude 对 and 好. The verb and its result stay together after the object.

src_py: qǐng ná chū shū lái
zh: 请把书拿出来。
py: qǐng bǎ shū ná chū lái
en: Please take out your books.
why: With 把 the book goes directly after it and the whole direction 拿出来 follows the verb. The object cannot be split inside the complement.

s: 我把这个新同事很喜欢。
s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè ge xīn tóng shì hěn xǐ huan
zh: 我很喜欢这个新同事。
py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhè ge xīn tóng shì
en: I really like this new colleague.
why: 喜欢 does not do anything to its object, so it cannot take 把.

zh: 他把那份合同签了。
py: tā bǎ nà fèn hé tong qiān le
en: He signed that contract.
why: 那份合同 is specific, so it follows 把. 签 then needs 了 as its ending, because a bare verb cannot close a 把 sentence.

src_py: wǒ bǎ zhè fèn bào gào xiě wán
zh: 我想把这份报告写完。
py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè fèn bào gào xiě wán
en: I want to finish writing this report.
why: 想 goes before 把. The specific object and 写完 follow as usual, with no 了 for something not yet done.

src_py: tā qí zǒu le wǒ de zì xíng chē
zh: 他把我的自行车骑走了。
py: tā bǎ wǒ de zì xíng chē qí zǒu le
en: He rode off on my bike.
why: My bike is specific, so it goes forward with 把. 骑走 stays together and 了 ends the sentence.

q: 这么多作业，我今天做___完。
zh: 这么多作业，我今天做不完。
py: zhè me duō zuò yè wǒ jīn tiān zuò bù wán
en: With this much homework, I can't finish it today.
why: 做不完 is a potential complement saying the result cannot be reached, and it never combines with 把. 没 or 了 would not give a 'cannot manage' meaning.

s: 我把今天开会的时间忘了。
s_py: wǒ bǎ jīn tiān kāi huì de shí jiān wàng le
zh: 我把今天开会的时间忘了。
py: wǒ bǎ jīn tiān kāi huì de shí jiān wàng le
en: I forgot the time of today's meeting.
why: 忘 is a mental verb, but it does take 把 when the thing is lost, and 了 gives it a proper ending.

zh: 别把会议时间弄错了。
py: bié bǎ huì yì shí jiān nòng cuò le
en: Don't get the meeting time wrong.
why: 别 goes before 把, and 弄错 stays together as verb plus result. 了 here marks the new situation of getting it wrong.

zh: 你可以把自行车停在门口。
py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ zì xíng chē tíng zài mén kǒu
en: You can park your bike at the door.
why: The modal 可以 stands before 把, never between the object and the verb. 停在门口 follows the object as one unit.

src_py: sī jī sòng wǒ men dào xué xiào le
zh: 司机把我们送到学校了。
py: sī jī bǎ wǒ men sòng dào xué xiào le
en: The driver took us to school.
why: 送到 plus a place works well with 把: the people being taken go forward, and the destination follows 送到.

src_py: qǐng dǎ sǎo bàn gōng shì
task: Rewrite with 把 and 一下.
zh: 请把办公室打扫一下。
py: qǐng bǎ bàn gōng shì dǎ sǎo yī xià
en: Please give the office a tidy.
why: The office goes after 把, and 一下 is the minimal ending that the verb needs.

s: 同学们把教室打扫。
s_py: tóng xué men bǎ jiào shì dǎ sǎo
zh: 同学们把教室打扫干净了。
py: tóng xué men bǎ jiào shì dǎ sǎo gān jìng le
en: The students cleaned the classroom.
why: A bare verb cannot close a 把 sentence. 打扫 needs a result, so 打扫干净了.

zh: 你把窗户擦一擦。
py: nǐ bǎ chuāng hu cā yī cā
en: Give the window a wipe.
why: The reduplicated 擦一擦 is the ending after 把, and the window goes before it. The doubled verb stays together after the object.

src_py: tā nòng huài le wǒ de diàn nǎo
zh: 他把我的电脑弄坏了。
py: tā bǎ wǒ de diàn nǎo nòng huài le
en: He broke my computer.
why: My computer is specific, so it goes forward with 把. 弄坏 stays glued together, and 了 goes last.

zh: 我没把课本带来。
py: wǒ méi bǎ kè běn dài lái
en: I didn't bring my textbook.
why: 没 goes before 把, not before the verb, and there is no 了 after it. 我把课本没带来 is the typical mistake.

zh: 同事还没把会议材料准备好。
py: tóng shì hái méi bǎ huì yì cái liào zhǔn bèi hǎo
en: My colleague hasn't got the meeting materials ready yet.
why: 还 and 没 both go before 把. After 没 the 了 is dropped, and 准备好 keeps its result together.

src_py: tā bǎ nà fèn bào gào kàn wán le
zh: 他看完了那份报告。
py: tā kàn wán le nà fèn bào gào
en: He finished reading that report.
why: With a specific object and a simple result both orders are correct. Without 把 the object follows 看完了.

q: 请问，我可以___车停在办公楼前面吗？
zh: 请问，我可以把车停在办公楼前面吗？
py: qǐng wèn wǒ kě yǐ bǎ chē tíng zài bàn gōng lóu qián miàn ma
en: Excuse me, may I park the car in front of the office building?
why: The object goes forward with 把, and the modal 可以 stands before it. 让 would mean letting the car do something, and 被 or 给 would reverse or change the roles.

s: 他把黑板上的字看清楚了。
s_py: tā bǎ hēi bǎn shàng de zì kàn qīng chu le
zh: 他把黑板上的字看清楚了。
py: tā bǎ hēi bǎn shàng de zì kàn qīng chu le
en: He read the words on the blackboard clearly.
why: 看 normally resists 把, but with a real result like 清楚 it is fine.

zh: 别把书包放在椅子上。
py: bié bǎ shū bāo fàng zài yǐ zi shàng
en: Don't put your schoolbag on the chair.
why: 别 comes first, before 把, and the object goes before the verb. 把书包别放 would put the negation in the wrong place.

q: 我已经把借来的笔记还___同桌了。
zh: 我已经把借来的笔记还给同桌了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ jiè lái de bǐ jì huán gěi tóng zhuō le
en: I've already given the borrowed notes back to my desk-mate.
why: 还给 is 'give back to' a person, so the recipient follows 给 and the notes go forward with 把. 还在 and 还到 do not take a person.

q: 小李把旧电脑卖___，买了一台新的。
zh: 小李把旧电脑卖了，买了一台新的。
py: xiǎo lǐ bǎ jiù diàn nǎo mài le mǎi le yī tái xīn de
en: Xiao Li sold his old computer and bought a new one.
why: A 把 sentence cannot end on a bare verb, and 了 is enough for 卖 because the object is gone. Leaving it out gives a bare verb; 着 and 过 do not fit a completed sale.

s: 我把这些作业做不完。
s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè xiē zuò yè zuò bù wán
zh: 我做不完这些作业。
py: wǒ zuò bù wán zhè xiē zuò yè
en: I can't finish this homework.
why: 做不完 says the result cannot be reached, and 把 cannot combine with it.

s: 我看懂了这封信。
s_py: wǒ kàn dǒng le zhè fēng xìn
zh: 我看懂了这封信。
py: wǒ kàn dǒng le zhè fēng xìn
en: I understood this letter.
why: Plain SVO with a result complement is correct. 把 is not required here.

s: 学校把考试改到了下个月。
s_py: xué xiào bǎ kǎo shì gǎi dào le xià ge yuè
zh: 学校把考试改到了下个月。
py: xué xiào bǎ kǎo shì gǎi dào le xià ge yuè
en: The school has moved the exam to next month.
why: 改到 plus a time is a destination pattern with the specific object forward after 把.

src_py: tā bǎ wén jiàn ná huí lái le
zh: 他没把文件拿回来。
py: tā méi bǎ wén jiàn ná huí lái
en: He didn't bring the file back.
why: 没 goes before 把 and the 了 is dropped. 拿回来 stays as one block after the object.

zh: 老师把我的手机收起来了。
py: lǎo shī bǎ wǒ de shǒu jī shōu qǐ lái le
en: The teacher took my phone away.
why: My phone is specific, so it goes right after 把, and the whole direction 收起来 follows the verb as one block, then 了.

q: 同学们都把小王当___班长。
zh: 同学们都把小王当作班长。
py: tóng xué men dōu bǎ xiǎo wáng dàng zuò bān zhǎng
en: All the classmates treat Xiao Wang as the class monitor.
why: 当作 means 'treat as', and the object must go forward with 把. 当到, 当在 and 当给 are not words.

src_py: wǒ wàng le zhè jiàn shì
zh: 我把这件事忘了。
py: wǒ bǎ zhè jiàn shì wàng le
en: I forgot about this.
why: 忘 is the usual verb that takes 把 with just 了, because the thing is lost. The object goes before the verb.

s: 昨天我在书店把一本新书买了。
s_py: zuó tiān wǒ zài shū diàn bǎ yī běn xīn shū mǎi le
zh: 昨天我在书店买了一本新书。
py: zuó tiān wǒ zài shū diàn mǎi le yī běn xīn shū
en: I bought a new book at the bookshop yesterday.
why: 一本新书 is a new, unspecified object, so it stays after the verb instead of going after 把.

src: 小李把这个问题解决了。
src_py: xiǎo lǐ bǎ zhè ge wèn tí jiě jué le
zh: 小李解决了这个问题。
py: xiǎo lǐ jiě jué le zhè ge wèn tí
en: Xiao Li solved this problem.
why: With a specific object and a simple result both orders are correct. In plain SVO the 了 follows the verb and the object comes last.

src_py: tā mài le jiù shǒu jī
zh: 他把旧手机卖了。
py: tā bǎ jiù shǒu jī mài le
en: He sold his old phone.
why: 卖 needs an ending after 把, and 了 is enough because the object is gone. A bare 卖 would not be allowed.

s: 你把这件事不要告诉同事。
s_py: nǐ bǎ zhè jiàn shì bù yào gào su tóng shì
zh: 你不要把这件事告诉同事。
py: nǐ bù yào bǎ zhè jiàn shì gào su tóng shì
en: Don't tell your colleagues about this.
why: 不要 goes before 把, never after the object.

zh: 请把作业本交上来。
py: qǐng bǎ zuò yè běn jiāo shàng lái
en: Please hand in your exercise books.
why: Object right after 把, then 交上来 as one block. 请交上来把作业本 and 请把交上来作业本 both break the order.

q: 他把椅子搬___教室里去了。
zh: 他把椅子搬进教室里去了。
py: tā bǎ yǐ zi bān jìn jiào shì lǐ qù le
en: He carried the chair into the classroom.
why: The direction after 搬 must match 'into the classroom': 搬进...去. 搬出 would mean out of it, and 搬下 and 搬起 do not take a room as a destination.

src_py: lǎo shī bǎ zuò yè běn fā wán le
zh: 老师发完了作业本。
py: lǎo shī fā wán le zuò yè běn
en: The teacher has finished handing out the exercise books.
why: Without 把 the object returns after the verb. 发完 and 了 come first, then the object.

src: 经理看完了所有的申请。
src_py: jīng lǐ kàn wán le suǒ yǒu de shēn qǐng
task: Rewrite with 把 and put 都 after the object.
zh: 经理把所有的申请都看完了。
py: jīng lǐ bǎ suǒ yǒu de shēn qǐng dōu kàn wán le
en: The manager has read all the applications.
why: 都 sums up the object, so it sits right after it and before the verb phrase. The verb keeps 完 and 了.

q: 他把文件一直放___抽屉里，没拿出来过。
zh: 他把文件一直放在抽屉里，没拿出来过。
py: tā bǎ wén jiàn yī zhí fàng zài chōu ti lǐ méi ná chū lái guo
en: He kept the file in the drawer the whole time and never took it out.
why: 放在 marks where something rests, which fits 一直 and a file that stays put. 放到 would stress being moved there, and 放给 or 放成 make no sense.

q: 小王把会议室打扫___了，大家可以进去了。
zh: 小王把会议室打扫干净了，大家可以进去了。
py: xiǎo wáng bǎ huì yì shì dǎ sǎo gān jìng le dà jiā kě yǐ jìn qù le
en: Xiao Wang cleaned the meeting room, so everyone can go in now.
why: 打扫干净 is the resultative that fits cleaning a room. 明白, 清楚 and 容易 are results of understanding or ease, not of sweeping.

zh: 老师把试卷发完了。
py: lǎo shī bǎ shì juàn fā wán le
en: The teacher has handed out all the test papers.
why: Subject, 把, specific object, then verb with its result 完 and 了 at the end. The object cannot follow 发完.

src: 小王把这份文件打印出来。
src_py: xiǎo wáng bǎ zhè fèn wén jiàn dǎ yìn chū lái
zh: 小王应该把这份文件打印出来。
py: xiǎo wáng yīng gāi bǎ zhè fèn wén jiàn dǎ yìn chū lái
en: Xiao Wang should print out this document.
why: 应该 goes before 把. The direction 出来 stays with the verb after the object.

q: 同事们把剩下的蛋糕吃___，一点儿也没留。
zh: 同事们把剩下的蛋糕吃了，一点儿也没留。
py: tóng shì men bǎ shèng xià de dàn gāo chī le yī diǎn r yě méi liú
en: My colleagues ate up the rest of the cake and left none.
why: 吃 uses up its object, so 把 plus verb plus 了 is a complete ending. A bare 吃 is not allowed after 把, and 着 and 过 do not describe finishing off the cake.

src_py: wǒ néng zuò wán zhè xiē zuò yè
zh: 我能把这些作业做完。
py: wǒ néng bǎ zhè xiē zuò yè zuò wán
en: I can get this homework done.
why: The modal 能 goes before 把, and the specific object goes in front of the verb 做完.

zh: 你听得懂老师的话吗？
py: nǐ tīng de dǒng lǎo shī de huà ma
en: Can you understand what the teacher says?
why: 听得懂 is a potential complement, which never takes 把. The object can follow the verb or be moved to the front as a topic.

q: 同事把我送___地铁站，然后就回去了。
zh: 同事把我送到地铁站，然后就回去了。
py: tóng shì bǎ wǒ sòng dào dì tiě zhàn rán hòu jiù huí qù le
en: My colleague saw me off to the subway station and then went back.
why: 送 plus 到 gives the place someone is taken to. 送在 does not exist, 送给 needs a person, and 送成 means turning into something else.

src: 他把这个句子翻译成中文。
src_py: tā bǎ zhè ge jù zi fān yì chéng zhōng wén
zh: 他没把这个句子翻译成中文。
py: tā méi bǎ zhè ge jù zi fān yì chéng zhōng wén
en: He didn't translate this sentence into Chinese.
why: 没 goes before 把, and 翻译成 keeps the new form 中文 directly after it.

q: 小王把电脑拿___了，现在办公室里没有。
zh: 小王把电脑拿走了，现在办公室里没有。
py: xiǎo wáng bǎ diàn nǎo ná zǒu le xiàn zài bàn gōng shì lǐ méi yǒu
en: Xiao Wang took the computer away; it isn't in the office now.
why: 拿走 is the directional ending that fits 'taken away', matching the computer no longer being in the office. 拿完 and 拿对 do not make sense here.

q: 请你把办公桌擦___擦，上面有很多灰。
zh: 请你把办公桌擦一擦，上面有很多灰。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ bàn gōng zhuō cā yī cā shàng miàn yǒu hěn duō huī
en: Please give the desk a wipe; it's covered in dust.
why: With no result or direction, the verb can be repeated as 擦一擦 to end the 把 clause. 不 and 没 would turn it into an A-not-A form, and 在 would mean 'is wiping'.

s: 我把作业没做完。
s_py: wǒ bǎ zuò yè méi zuò wán
zh: 我没把作业做完。
py: wǒ méi bǎ zuò yè zuò wán
en: I didn't finish my homework.
why: 没 stands before 把, not between the object and the verb.

src_py: tóng xué cā gān jìng le hēi bǎn
zh: 同学把黑板擦干净了。
py: tóng xué bǎ hēi bǎn cā gān jìng le
en: The student wiped the blackboard clean.
why: 把 moves the blackboard in front of the verb, and 擦干净 keeps its result together with 了 at the end.

q: 上课的时候，___把手机放在桌子上。
zh: 上课的时候，别把手机放在桌子上。
py: shàng kè de shí hou bié bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
en: Don't leave your phone on the desk during class.
why: A prohibition is 别 placed before 把. 没 reports something that did not happen, and 不是 and 不会 do not give an instruction.

zh: 我想把这本书看完。
py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè běn shū kàn wán
en: I want to finish this book.
why: 想 stands before 把 and the object before the verb. 看完 keeps its result, and there is no 了 because it has not happened yet.
